XMLDB.COMMENT: All-in-one LOCAL override: upstream local/ulibot/db/install.xml ships an empty TABLES section by design (the table is created lazily by local_ulibot_ensure_schema), but Moodle 4.5's installer rejects an empty install.xml. This override defines the table at install time so the plugin installs on a fresh site. Mounted into the container only; the plugin repo is untouched. local_ulibot_ensure_schema() guards on table_exists, so there is no double-create.
